name: Scandinavian Hub Under-Desk Cable Management Trays (set of 2)
caption:
Two trays, zero cable mess. 🧹

These Scandinavian Hub steel trays screw on under the desk and hold the power strip and every cable out of sight.

Tip: drop the power strip in first, then run each cable along the tray before plugging it in.
